checks.scope_and_contracts: Ticket criteria and selected canonical evidence closure inspected; no domain schema changes.
checks.ownership: Standalone scene owns nodes and view/capture controls; Python owns execution/provenance and canonical evidence validation. Existing process/toolchain/output helpers reused.
checks.abstractions: Only the existing extractor accepts a bounded selection; no generic graphics framework or new global class.
checks.typed_gdscript: Typed scene dependencies, methods and collections; dynamic request object is validated at the JSON boundary.
checks.scene_lifecycle: Scene loads and awaits actual rendered frames; controls locked during automated sequence; wired capture/reset exercised. Scene-only process exits cleanly.
checks.shared_resources: Fixture materials mutated only inside this one standalone scene/process. No gameplay Resources or production state touched.
checks.runtime_logs: Pinned import and committed graphical run have no SCRIPT ERROR/ERROR/WARNING records.
checks.network_authority: N/A: local graphical presentation test; no RPC, gameplay, persistence or connected peers changed.
checks.protected_standards: No AGENTS.md or docs/ai file changed. mmo_docs writes explicitly authorized by execute-ticket.
checks.git_scope: Only probe, required regressions/docs and metadata-only canonical snapshot refresh; no original edits existed.
checks.function_responsibility_review: Scene execution method sequences one finite graphical scenario; launcher main sequences one isolated run. Neither owns gameplay rules or arbitrary future cases.
checks.visual_limitations: No human art approval, export, motion/performance/DPI or other GPU/platform certification.
